templates.name: Market Research Report
templates.description: Flagship firm-quality market research report with sizing, forecast, competitive and regional analysis.
templates.generationPrompt: Produce a firm-quality market research report on {scope} over the horizon {horizon} for the {region} market. Follow the section scaffold exactly and in order.

templates.name: Executive Summary / Brief
templates.description: A concise executive brief distilling the key findings, implications, and recommendations.
templates.generationPrompt: Write a concise executive summary brief on {scope} over {horizon} for the {region} market, distilling findings, implications, and recommendations.

templates.name: Competitive Landscape
templates.description: A structured competitor comparison table across positioning, share, strengths, and weaknesses.
templates.generationPrompt: Build a competitive landscape comparison for {scope} over {horizon} in the {region} market as a table of competitors and their positioning, share, strengths, and weaknesses.

templates.name: Market Forecast Model
templates.description: A quantitative market forecast model laid out as a year-by-year projection table.
templates.generationPrompt: Construct a market forecast model for {scope} over {horizon} in the {region} market as a year-by-year table of market size, growth rate, and key drivers.

templates.name: SWOT / Porter's Five Forces
templates.description: A strategic analysis combining SWOT with Porter's Five Forces.
templates.generationPrompt: Perform a SWOT and Porter's Five Forces analysis of {scope} over {horizon} in the {region} market.

templates.name: Company / Vendor Profile
templates.description: A structured profile of a company or vendor covering overview, offerings, and outlook.
templates.generationPrompt: Write a company/vendor profile for {scope} as of {horizon} in the {region} market, covering overview, offerings, financials, and outlook.

templates.name: Customer / Buyer Insights
templates.description: An analysis of buyer segments, needs, journey, and decision criteria.
templates.generationPrompt: Analyze customer/buyer insights for {scope} over {horizon} in the {region} market, covering segments, needs, journey, and decision criteria.

templates.name: Trend / Technology Scan
templates.description: A scan of emerging trends and technologies with maturity and impact assessment.
templates.generationPrompt: Produce a trend and technology scan for {scope} over {horizon} in the {region} market, covering emerging trends, maturity, impact, and a watch list.
